ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious SysAidServer Child
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of SysAidServer (as seen in MERCURY threat actor intrusions)

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\java\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\javaw\\\.exe$")) AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*SysAidServer.*"))
